title: Topology graph and AWS inventory are out of sync
rationale: At least one topology resource identifier does not match the latest scoped AWS inventory snapshot.
decisionsTaken: Compared topology resource ARNs to scoped AWS inventory resources.json rows.

title: Orphaned AWS resource: AWS::EC2::Volume. Resource name was not stored.
decisionsTaken: Flagged unattached EBS volume, Elastic IP, or ENI from AWS inventory.

title: No topology resources were found
rationale: Required capabilities, topology hints, and constraints were not stored on the context snapshot; expected topology pillars use the engine legacy four-pillar default (not workload scope metadata). The graph does not contain any TopologyResource nodes.
decisionsTaken: No TopologyResource nodes found in graph — emitted coverage warning.
